en: In Isaiah 50, what did the servant not hide from insults and spitting?
In Isaiah 50, which insect will eat up the servant's accusers like a garment?
In Isaiah 50, what rots for lack of water when God dries the rivers?
In Isaiah 51, besides Abraham, which ancestor is Israel told to look to?
In Isaiah 51, the heavens will vanish like what?
In Isaiah 51, mortals who fade away are likened to what plant?
In Isaiah 53, before which workers is the servant silent like a sheep?
In Isaiah 53, to what did the suffering servant surrender himself?
In Isaiah 54, which gems will God use for Zion's foundations?
In Isaiah 57, what does God proclaim to those far and near?
In Isaiah 58, the prophet must raise his voice like which instrument?
In Isaiah 59, what armor does God put on his head?
In Isaiah 60, what has come, so Jerusalem must arise and shine?
In Isaiah 60, returning exiles fly like clouds and like which birds?
In Isaiah 60, which metal will God bring in place of iron?
In Isaiah 61, to whom does the Lord's anointed proclaim liberty?
In Isaiah 61, what span of the Lord's favor does the anointed proclaim?
In Isaiah 61, which people will be Israel's farmers and vinedressers?
In Isaiah 64, besides the eye, which body part never perceived another God?
In Isaiah 66, besides their fire, what never dies in the rebels' corpses?
In Isaiah 66, sacrificing a lamb is likened to killing which animal?
In Isaiah 66, besides priests, what will God make some gathered people?
